01 / ADVISORY

À la carte

€50 / hour

Best for occasional guidance, a focused review, or a specific people, process, or business question.

  • 2-hour minimum per booking
  • Up to 10 hours per booking
  • No recurring commitment
Ask about hourly support ↗
02 / DEFINED SCOPE

Project-based

€45 / hour*

Best for businesses delivering a defined initiative, from SOP development and process improvements to coordinated projects.

  • Typically 10–80 hours per project
  • Agreed milestones and deliverables
  • Fixed quote following scoping
Discuss a project ↗
03 / RECURRING SUPPORT

Ongoing packages

€40 / hour

Best for steady fractional support from one professional, with scope and specialist rates agreed for each engagement.

  • 10–40 hours per month
  • From €400/month for one professional (10 hours)
  • Monthly allocation agreed in advance
Explore monthly support ↗

*Project-based pricing uses €45/hour for estimating; the final fee is confirmed in a scope-based proposal. Ongoing support starts at €40/hour for one professional. Specialist rates depend on the expertise and agreed scope. All rates are in EUR and exclude applicable taxes.
